W3 (cost lens), after E036.

**Tip (E036).** E035 plus the whitening-bias detach after 20% of steps. That is 231 steps at batch 2000, resolutions 20/24/28/32 px at 30/10/30/30%, the stem frozen at 75%, and the whitening detached from step 46. Measured 5.314 s and 0.7532. The detach saved 0.13 s (−2.4%), at the top of my 0.05–0.15 s range. The 3-seed mean fell 0.16 pp, which is within noise, but the tip now sits exactly on the 0.753 bar. Any further cut needs either accuracy bought back or a held-out mean that is clearly above the bar.

**Code facts:**
- Muon renormalizes filters and uses no wd, so filter wd is inert.
- Newton-Schulz already runs 3 iterations.
- Group-1 BN runs at 15×15 after the pool, not at 31×31. Only conv1's output (31×31×128) and the pool are large-map work. Folding BN on the frozen stem therefore saves little.
- The whitening backward is now gone after 20% of steps. Later freeze-dose steps save only the group-1 conv/BN/GELU backward, about 0.006–0.007 s per step at 28/32 px.

**Time budget.** Time ≈ F (about 0.25 s) + Σ steps × per-step cost.
- Per step: 0.032 s at 32 px, 0.026 at 28, 0.021 at 24, 0.016 at 20, minus the detach and freeze savings.
- 0.5 epoch ≈ 0.3 s.
- Memory-bound savings have come in at or above face value every time (E028, E031, E034, E036). I no longer shade them down.

**Exchange rates (s saved per pp lost):**
- Epoch dial: 1.5–2.5.
- Freeze at 75%: about 2.
- Early low resolution: 1–2.
- Width cut: about 0.7 (bad).
- Loss-based dropping: about 2.
- Whitening detach: ≥1 (noisy).
- Freeze 75%→60%: about 0.2 s for about 0.15–0.2 pp, marginal.

**Accuracy boosters.** Every schedule and regularization tweak was ≤0 on held-out seeds (E025, E029, E030, E032). Prior for untested ones: −0.2 ± 0.25 pp. Only steps and Muon reliably buy accuracy.

**Mechanisms:**
1. Lookahead averaging is worth about 1 pp and is tuned (E005, E025, E030).
2. Muon is worth about 0.3–0.6 pp at about 3% time (E006, unconfounded test pending).
3. Accuracy is built at 28/32 px (E011, E018, E024, E026, E033).
4. Large-map backward is bandwidth-bound (E028, E034, E036).
5. An RNG re-draw or a "math-identical" fp change moves the 3-seed mean by ±0.1–0.3 pp (E035).

**Noise:**
- Per-seed std about 0.3 pp; 3-seed SE about 0.17 pp; 10-seed SE about 0.1 pp.
- Time noise about 1%.

**Unsure:**
- The tip's true population mean. With the winner's curse from about 12 keep decisions on seeds 3–12, it is probably 0.752–0.7535, which is thin above the 40-seed bar of 0.75 but fine.
- The freeze-dose curve below 75%.
- Whether the PCIe judge discounts bandwidth-bound savings.
- Whether the remaining big lever is architectural (group-1 conv1 at 31×31) rather than schedule.

forecasts.reason: 35 more truncated steps (23 at 28 px, 12 at 32 px) save about 0.2 s, since the whitening part is already gone. The time cut likely clears 3%, but a loss of about 0.15–0.2 pp sits right at the hypothesis's 0.15 pp limit.
No recipe change, so the harness metrics repeat the tip. The fresh-seed mean probably lands 0.05–0.1 pp below seeds 3–12, and the pooled mean sits near 0.753, a coin flip on that gate.
Group-1 BN runs at 15×15 after the pool, not at 31×31, so the frozen BN stats passes are small. Folding saves about 0.02 s, well short of 2%, and eval-mode BN adds accuracy risk.
E028's ~27% per-step saving from group-1 backward alone implies group 1 plus whitening forward and backward is ≥35% of a 32 px step. With batch 2000 fp16, BN and GELU are plausibly ≥30% of GPU time.
Removing Newton-Schulz and renorm saves about 2–3%. SGD at a linearly scaled lr with batch 2000 over about 230 steps likely loses ≥0.3 pp, which would confirm Muon is load-bearing.

cruxes: What is the E036 tip's held-out (seeds 3–12, and fresh seeds 13–22) mean? If it is ≥0.7545 there is room to spend on freeze dose and epochs; if it is ≈0.752, every further time cut must first buy accuracy back.

Profiler split for a 32 px step: what share is group-1 conv1 at 31×31 plus the pool (forward and backward), versus everything else? This sets whether a structural stem change (e.g. a stride-2 first conv) beats more freeze dose.
Is Muon's accuracy contribution ≥0.3 pp when unconfounded (I059)? If not, about 3% time is free; if so, Muon-lr/batch tuning is the remaining accuracy source to fund cuts.
